jobs.title: Standortentwickler (m/w/d)
jobs.description: „Jeden Tag einen Menschen in eine sinnstiftende Tätigkeit bringen.“ Eine Stadt. Ein leeres Blatt. Dein Name drunter. Berlin hat rund 3,9 Millionen Menschen, zwölf Bezirke, zwölf Jobcenter, eine Agentur für Arbeit mit mehreren Standorten – und einen Arbeitsmarkt, der dringend Menschen braucht, die qualifiziert, gecoacht und vermittelt werden. Wir sind in NRW, Schleswig-Holstein und Hamburg gewachsen. Jetzt wollen wir in Berlin Fuß fassen. Richtig. Dafür suchen wir keinen Verwalter und keinen Vertriebler, der nach Feierabend abschaltet. Wir suchen jemanden, der Berlin kennt, in Berlin vernetzt ist und Lust hat, aus dem Nichts einen Standort aufzubauen, der in drei Jahren ein Name im Berliner Bildungsmarkt ist. Du bekommst dafür die Rückendeckung einer etablierten Gruppe – und du wirst am Gewinn beteiligt, den du selbst erwirtschaftest. Kurz gesagt: Du gründest unser Berliner Geschäft – mit uns im Rücken und mit Anteil am Ergebnis. Wer wir sind Die EuBiA (Europäische Bildungsakademie) ist als operative Tochtergesellschaft der IWQ Holding ein Bildungsträger mit Standorten in NRW, Schleswig-Holstein und Hamburg sowie in Marokko. Seit über 15 Jahren konzipieren und realisieren wir geförderte Bildungsmaßnahmen, Coachings, Sprach- und Integrationskurse und Weiterbildungen – AZAV-zertifiziert, für Kostenträger, Firmenkunden und Selbstzahler, national und international. Was uns ausmacht: Herzlichkeit, Kompetenz und Engagement. Wir entscheiden schnell, arbeiten nah am Markt und nah an den Menschen. Bei uns arbeiten Kolleginnen und Kollegen unterschiedlichster Herkunft zusammen, wir beraten und unterrichten in mehreren Sprachen. Diversity is für uns kein Schlagwort, sondern gelebter Alltag. Deine Mission Du baust das gesamte Geschäft der EuBiA in Berlin auf – vom ersten Gespräch mit einem Kostenträger bis zum laufenden Standort mit Team, Teilnehmenden und schwarzen Zahlen. In dieser Reihenfolge, ungefähr: Markt und Netzwerk – Du gehst von Tag eins auf die Agentur für Arbeit, die Berliner Jobcenter, das BAMF, die Senatsverwaltungen, Kammern, Verbände und Unternehmen zu. Du findest heraus, welche Bedarfe in welchem Bezirk offen sind – und wo wir mit unserem Angebot sofort einen Unterschied machen. Standort – Du suchst und bewertest Räume, verhandelst, richtest ein und sorgst dafür, dass der Standort die Anforderungen der Kostenträger und der Zertifizierung erfüllt. Angebot – Du entscheidest mit, welche Maßnahmen Berlin zuerst braucht – Coaching und Vermittlung (AVGS, § 45 SGB III), Weiterbildung (FBW), Sprach- und Integrationskurse, Firmenschulungen, Ausschreibungen – und bringst sie mit unserem QM-Team durch die Zulassung. Vertrieb – Du gewinnst Kostenträger, Firmenkunden und Kooperationspartner, bearbeitest Ausschreibungen und füllst die Maßnahmen mit Teilnehmenden. Du verkaufst nicht nur – du hältst, was du verkaufst. Team – Du stellst Coaches, Dozentinnen und Dozenten und Verwaltung ein, baust die Mannschaft auf, führst sie und machst sie stark. Betrieb und Zahlen – Du verantwortest Budget, Auslastung, Ergebnis. Du kennst deine Kennzahlen jede Woche – Teilnehmende, Verbleib, Deckungsbeitrag – und steuerst danach. Hands-on – Am Anfang bist du alles gleichzeitig: Vertrieb, Coach, Verwaltung, Hausmeister. Das schreckt dich nicht, das reizt dich. Was du mitbringst Berlin – Du lebst in Berlin, kennst die Stadt, die Bezirke, die Akteure – und hast bereits ein belastbares Netzwerk zu Kostenträgern, Verwaltungen, Unternehmen oder Trägern. Du weißt, wer in Berlin was entscheidet. Arbeitsmarktdienstleistungen – Du kennst das Geschäft aus eigener Praxis: SGB II und SGB III, AZAV, AVGS, FBW, § 45, Ausschreibungen der Kostenträger, Integrations- und Berufssprachkurse. Du weißt, wie Maßnahmen zugelassen, gefüllt, abgerechnet und geprüft werden. Geschäftstüchtigkeit – Du denkst wie eine Unternehmerin oder ein Unternehmer: Du erkennst Chancen, rechnest sie durch, entscheidest schnell und bringst sie auf die Straße. Du hast schon einmal etwas aufgebaut

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Applied AI
jobs.description: About CircuitHub CircuitHub is reshaping electronics manufacturing with The Grid, a factory-scale robotics platform that makes small-batch, high-mix electronics assembly radically more efficient. Think semiconductor-fab precision applied to the chaotic world of prototyping and low-volume production: a 10x throughput improvement in one of the world's most foundational industries. We've raised $45M from top-tier investors including Plural, Y Combinator and Google Ventures, and we're already profitable. Our customers include a major EV maker, a top AI lab and many of the worlds largest companies. The Grid isn't a prototype. It's live, scaling fast and delivering real revenue, and we're building the team that will scale it further. The Role CircuitHub makes electronics on demand. Engineers upload a circuit board design; we buy the parts, build the board in our own robotic factory and ship it. More and more of that business is now run by AI agents, and we want you to help build them. These aren't chatbots. Our agents have real jobs: They inspect boards. An agent checks camera images of every panel we build for wrong, rotated or missing parts. They program robots. Agents read datasheets so our pick-and-place machines know how to handle each new part. They watch the factory. They spot stray parts in robot storage, diagnose printer faults and clear stuck machines. They run the back office. They book supplier invoices, chase late orders, explain quotes and triage bugs. They write our code. Most of what our team ships starts in an agent session. What you'll do Find a process people still do by hand and automate it end to end: decide what needs judgement and what needs plain code, build the tools, and prove it works before it runs alone. Then make it cheaper, faster and right more often. You'll also improve the platform every agent runs on, and work closely with the people your work serves, from factory operators to finance. How we build Evals first. An agent earns the right to work alone: blind tests against people's verdicts, shadow runs beside the humans, replays of past decisions. We track accuracy and cost per run, and re-test whenever we change a model, a prompt or the effort level. Agents judge, code writes. Agents return structured answers. Plain code checks them against a second source and makes every change. Classical first, model second. Cheap vision and maths narrow the problem so the model only looks where it matters. Safe by construction. Agents work in sandboxed cloud machines that never hold real credentials, and tool calls are built so a business action can't run twice. Recent work Image alignment ranks the parts on each board photo. The worst 20% of parts hold about 90% of real defects, so the agent only inspects those. In a blind re-run it caught all 13 defects operators had marked. A photo check for stray parts in robot storage scored 10 out of 10 blind, at about 8¢ a photo. The model it replaced caught about half. Agent tool calls leave durable receipts, so a session killed mid-deploy resumes without sending the same email or order twice. Invoices extracted from supplier emails matched what a person had entered 66 times out of 66. A constraint solver replans the whole factory every two minutes, across robots, ovens and people. What we look for You've put LLM agents into production and can tell us what broke and how you knew it was working. You're a strong software engineer first. Most of this job is real engineering, not prompting: concurrency, idempotency, data modelling, security. You build the eval before you trust the result. You like the physical world: cameras, robots, parts rotated by 90°. Bonus: computer vision, optimisation or electronics. Stack Agents: Claude Code, Codex, Claude and OpenAI APIs, MCP, skills in plain Markdown Code: TypeScript (Bun, React), Python (FastAPI, Dagster, OpenCV, OR-Tools), PostgreSQL Infra: Nix and NixOS, Nomad, Terraform, Vault, AWS, Modal sandboxes, OpenTelemetry Pay UK £80k–£12

jobs.title: BDR Manager
jobs.description: About Kernel Agents are starting to sell, buy and operate on behalf of companies. But before an agent can close a deal, qualify an account, route a lead or assess risk, it has to answer a basic question: which company is this? Today, that answer is messy, and no one answers it reliably. Business identity lives across CRMs, ERPs and third-party datasets full of duplicates, missing parent companies, stale addresses and incorrect enrichment. The cost shows up across the enterprise: sales teams miss revenue opportunities because they lack the right account context; operations teams take on avoidable exposure because risk signals are fragmented or wrong; and finance teams end up chasing, writing off, or defaulting on bad debt that should have been caught earlier. Humans have worked around that mess for years. Agents cannot. They need a reliable business identity layer they can trust. Kernel is building that layer: the business registry for agents. We issue a permanent KERN ID for every business, plus the context an agent needs to act on it. Ops, data and revenue teams at Gong, Legora, Mistral, Canva and Checkout already use Kernel on their own systems. Agents are next, and there will be far more of them. We have raised $14M from top VCs and operators at Plaid, OpenAI, Slack and others, and we are growing 5x YoY. The Role We have strong product market fit. In 2025 we grew ~5x with world class net dollar retention, mostly from founder-led sales, and now have AEs hitting quota with an emerging playbook. We're looking for another BDR Manager to accelerate our outbound engine as we scale in 2026. You'll own a team of ~10 BDRs and be responsible for the pipeline that fuels our growth. You will report to Dave Bentham (Head of Sales) and work closely with our AEs, marketing, and leadership team to make sure the top of funnel is consistently feeding high-quality pipeline. What You’ll Be Doing Set the strategy Work with Dave and the rest of leadership to define ICP, targeting, and outbound messaging. Translate company targets into clear, measurable BDR goals and ensure pipeline expectations are distributed strategically across the team. Continuously iterate on outbound plays, channels, and sequences to improve conversion at every stage. Develop the BDR team to be a talent pool for the rest of the organisation through a culture of constant learning Set your team Manage and develop a team of ~10 BDRs across inbound and outbound. Work alongside our recruiters to grow the team as we scale. Be accountable for team performance. Coach underperformers, promote top performers, and set a high bar across the board. Our BDR team is the talent engine for the entire GTM team. Nurturing the best people and helping them be ready for the next role is crucial. Set the operating cadence Define qualification criteria and handoff processes that set AEs up to close. Build repeatable outbound plays that convert, and partner with marketing where needed. Establish pipeline generation rigor: activity metrics, and predictable output. Run weekly team reviews, call coaching sessions, and continuous improvement loops. What You Bring: 4+ years in business development and/or outbound sales, with at least some time managing a BDR or SDR team. Experience scaling a BDR team (e.g. growing from a handful of reps to 10+) or managing a team of that size. Strong instincts for messaging, targeting, and what makes outbound actually work. Comfort operating in ambiguity: you can build process, playbooks, and territory strategy. jobs.title: Alliance & Delivery Manager, Pharma Partnerships
jobs.description: About Orakl Oncology At Orakl Oncology, we combine patient-derived tumor models, experimental drug screening and computational modelling to improve oncology drug development. Our research brings together functional treatment-response measurements, molecular profiles and clinical information where available, creating opportunities to investigate how experimental responses translate into patient outcomes. Our platforms are designed to help anticipate clinical trial outcomes, evaluate therapies and identify new therapeutic opportunities. Our mission is simple yet ambitious: to bring more effective treatments to patients who need them and to make drug development smarter, faster, and more personalised. We collaborate with top hospitals, research institutes, and pharmaceutical companies worldwide. Backed by leading investors, we are a fast-growing, mission-driven startup at the intersection of science and technology. About the Role We are looking for an Alliance & Delivery Manager to own Orakl's pharma partnerships after signature: the partner relationship, the delivery of each research program, and the growth of each account. Orakl runs research programs for pharmaceutical companies on its virtual patient cohorts, combining compound screening, multi-omics and O-Predict analyses on the partner's assets. Several programs run in parallel on the same wet-lab and dry-lab teams, and the portfolio is growing. Delivery quality directly drives renewals and follow-on contracts. This is a high-ownership, partner-facing role . You are the partner's main contact, you are accountable for delivery across our wet-lab and dry-lab teams, and you grow existing accounts. You will also scale our delivery processes and tooling: project tracking, capacity planning and partner reporting, automated wherever possible. You will work closely with the Scientific Program & Operations Lead, Business Development, the Wet Lab, Data Science and Computational Biology leads, and Product. As the ideal candidate, you have already delivered complex scientific programs for pharma clients, and you are an expert at establishing partner trust. What You'll Do Own partner relationships: act as the main point of contact for each pharma partner from kick-off to final delivery. Map decision-makers, priorities and expectations for their asset, run the steering committees, attend key international conferences a few times per year and present results alongside our scientific teams. Lead program delivery: translate each signed contract into an executable plan for the Wet Lab and Dry Lab teams, with owners, milestones and deliverables. Own the timeline, coordinate the experimental and computational work, and ensure every deliverable passes internal QC and review before it reaches the partner. Manage capacity across programs: plan capacity with the Wet Lab and Dry Lab leads, arbitrate conflicts between programs and protect committed timelines. Centralise requests on delivery teams coming from partners and Business Development. Manage risk and change: anticipate delivery risks, including results that change the plan, and escalate to the Scientific Program & Operations Lead with a recommendation. Agree and document scope and timeline changes with partners. Scale delivery processes and tooling: scale our project management system in Asana, from program templates and timelines to portfolio and capacity views. Automate reporting and follow-up, deploy AI tools where they remove manual work, and document how we run programs. Grow existing accounts: identify, qualify and convert follow-on opportunities within existing partnerships. Work with Business Development on scoping, proposals and pricing, and provide a feasibility assessment before anything is committed. Plan scientific and BD materials: schedule conference and BD material cycles as part of the delivery plan, and coordinate partner approvals for any communication based on partnered programs. Minimum Qualifications 4+ year

jobs.description: About Voodoo Voodoo is a consumer tech company founded in Paris in 2013, with one mission: entertain the world. Today we are 1,000 people, generating $1b+ in annual revenue, profitably. Our games and apps have passed 7 billion downloads and reach 200 million+ active users every month, making Voodoo the #3 mobile publisher worldwide in downloads, after Google and Meta. We were backed by Goldman Sachs, Tencent and GBL along the way. Team The Engineering & Data team builds innovative tech products and platforms to support the impressive growth of their gaming and consumer apps which allow Voodoo to stay at the forefront of the mobile gaming industry. Helix is our flagship Ad-Network team of around 60 top-tier engineers and data scientists spanning backend, mobile SDKs, data engineering, infrastructure, and AI. Helix has evolved beyond powering Voodoo's own gaming portfolio—our technology is now directly integrated into games from external, third-party publishers worldwide. Operating across millions of third-party devices in real-time bidding environments creates unique technical challenges around SDK performance, ultra-low latency, and intelligent automation. Within Helix, you'll join the RTB team, the group that owns the bidder and the services behind it that help it take the optimal bidding decision. Bidder, pricing, models and data are all built in-house, so nothing is out of reach when you want to change how a bid gets made. You will work with expert backend and machine-learning engineers in real-time bidding, on a system that prices ad requests across mobile gaming in real time, at a scale few teams get to work at. Role We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager - Real Time Bidding to join our Engineering & Data team. In this role, you’ll drive product decisions across the full bidding pipeline. You'll own projects end-to-end: roadmap, trade-offs, shipping, and cross-team contract. You will also: Own the roadmap of the bidding pipeline. How we target, price, pace and cap, and what goes live in the bid path and when. Own the delivery. Adapt to changes, set clear priorities, communicate effectively Own experimentation as a product. Other teams test ideas on the bidder through the framework we build. You make sure they can run the experiments they need, trust the results, and get an answer fast. Keep the pieces fitting together. You spot a change in one team that will break another before it reaches production. Contribute to the product strategy beyond your scope. Profile (Must have) Experience in programmatic advertising. You have worked on pricing, bidding or auction logic on a DSP, bidder or exchange, you know the pipeline from bid request to win, and you can explain the business impact of your work. Analytical mindset. You back decisions with data and understand the statistical basis of pricing and experimentation. You own outcomes across teams. When a change in one team is about to break another, you catch it and drive the fix before it ships. You use AI tooling daily to write specs, analyse data and prototype, and you move faster because of it. jobs.title: Apporteur d’affaires indépendant
jobs.description: 🚀 Apporteur d’affaires indépendant — Développez votre réseau avec PropertyOS 100 % à distance · Organisation libre · Commission sur les ventes issues de vos recommandations Vous aimez créer des contacts, repérer des opportunités et mettre les bonnes personnes en relation ? Avec PropertyOS, vous identifiez des propriétaires, bailleurs ou petites agences intéressés par une gestion immobilière plus simple. Vous organisez le rendez-vous : le fondateur assure la démonstration et le closing. 🏡 PropertyOS, c’est quoi ? PropertyOS est une plateforme SaaS qui centralise les biens immobiliers, les locataires, les finances, les documents et les tâches dans un même espace. Notre ambition : permettre aux propriétaires et gestionnaires de gagner du temps et de garder une vision claire de leur activité immobilière. La plateforme est accessible directement en ligne. Nous développons également un réseau de partenaires indépendants pour la faire découvrir à de nouveaux clients grâce à une approche plus personnelle. 🎯 Votre mission : créer des opportunités qualifiées Votre rôle consiste à : Identifier des propriétaires bailleurs, investisseurs et petites agences susceptibles d’être intéressés. Entrer en contact avec eux et comprendre leur organisation actuelle. Présenter simplement PropertyOS et son intérêt. Vérifier leur intérêt pour une démonstration et pour le budget proposé. Organiser un rendez-vous avec le fondateur. Enregistrer les informations utiles dans PropertyOS Advisor pour préparer l’échange. Vous vous concentrez sur la prospection et la mise en relation. Le fondateur prend ensuite le relais pour la démonstration détaillée, les questions commerciales, la négociation et la conclusion de l’abonnement. Vous ne négociez pas les conditions et ne signez pas de contrat au nom de PropertyOS. ⚡ PropertyOS Advisor : votre application partenaire Vous disposez de PropertyOS Advisor , notre application dédiée aux apporteurs d’affaires. Pensée pour fluidifier votre activité, elle vous permet de centraliser les informations de vos prospects, suivre vos mises en relation et transmettre le contexte nécessaire à la préparation des rendez-vous. L’objectif : une prospection organisée et un passage de relais simple , pour donner à chaque opportunité les meilleures chances d’aboutir. 💸 Une rémunération liée aux clients apportés L’offre mise en avant dans ce partenariat est l’abonnement annuel PropertyOS à 990 € . Vous percevez une commission pour chaque nouveau client qui souscrit et règle cet abonnement à la suite de votre mise en relation, selon les conditions prévues au contrat. Rémunération à la commission uniquement. Aucun salaire fixe ni revenu garanti. Le montant de la commission et le calendrier de versement sont communiqués avant tout engagement. Les règles d’attribution des prospects, de traitement des doublons et d’annulation sont précisées au contrat. Un rendez-vous seul ne déclenche pas de commission : celle-ci dépend de la souscription et de l’encaissement correspondants. 👋 À qui s’adresse cette opportunité ? À des personnes autonomes, à l’aise dans les échanges et capables de créer un premier contact de qualité. Vous pouvez avoir une expérience commerciale, un réseau dans l’immobilier ou simplement une vraie capacité à prospecter avec méthode. Nous recherchons surtout : De l’écoute , pour repérer un besoin réel. De la clarté , pour expliquer la solution sans faire de promesses excessives. De la régularité , pour développer votre activité. De la rigueur , pour transmettre des informations fiables. Un bon relationnel , pour représenter PropertyOS avec professionnalisme. Une expérience en prospection, en immobilier ou dans le SaaS est un atout. Vous n’avez pas besoin d’être un expert du logiciel ni un closer confirmé. 🌴 Notre culture : détendue, directe et orientée résultats Chez PropertyOS, on apprécie les échanges simples, les idées utiles et les personnes qui prennent des initiatives. Vous organisez librement votre activité : pas d’horaire

We are looking for a Network Engineer (IT/OT) to design, build, and operate the network architecture supporting our Amsterdam headquarters, first production facility, and future sites. The position is based at our headquarters in Amsterdam. Expect regular travel to the production site during construction and commissioning, becoming occasional once the site is in operation. jobs.description: Who are we? Gain is the Private Markets Super App, a connected global platform transforming how leading investors, advisors, and corporates source, evaluate, and execute deals. By combining investment-grade intelligence, AI-powered workflows, and proprietary data in one unified platform, Gain enables top deal teams to move faster, reduce risk, and build conviction with confidence. Gain is trusted across more than $1 trillion of private capital, used by 100% of MBB and Big Four firms, and by 80% of the world’s top 20 M&A advisory houses. Recognized for fast innovation and impact, Gain has been named both US and EU Data Provider of the Year by PE Wire, awarded Global Financial Market Review’s Best Use of AI in Finance, and ranked in Sifted’s Top 100 Fastest-Growing Companies, the Forbes 1000, and the Deloitte Technology Fast 50. Gain operates globally with offices in New York, London, Amsterdam, Frankfurt, Warsaw, and Bangalore. How we work Predicting what isn't published. Many private companies publish little or no financial detail. Across a database of more than 5 million companies, we predict revenue and EBITDA from sparse labels, and we predict whether and when a company will be bought or sold, which is a time-to-event problem with censored data. Agents on a messy web. Our agents search, navigate and extract company data points from sources that contradict each other, then decide which source to trust before committing to an answer. Quality that holds while everything underneath moves. We're provider-agnostic. Model choices follow the evals, and we switch LLMs when the numbers say so. That only works if the evals are trusted. What will you do? The work is roughly half LLM agents and half custom ML, leaning slightly toward agents. The design of our agent pipelines: architecture, tools, and which model for which task. You'll shape the technical direction with our AI Lead. The evaluation behind agents and models: offline reference sets, live production evals, and the call on whether an improvement is real. Our prediction models for financials and deals: features, validation, retraining, and knowing when a simpler model wins. Getting work into production: trace where pipelines fail and fix the weakest links first, with compute, memory and model cost in view. Raising the bar in the team through design reviews, pairing, and an eval-first habit that sticks. In your first six months you'll own the evals for our agent pipelines, propose where we invest next, and ship measurable improvements to both the agents and the prediction models. Who are you? You've built and owned ML systems in production for years, typically 6+ in ML or software engineering. In the last 1–2 years you've shipped LLM agents or pipelines that real users depend on, not demos. You have modelling judgement. You've dealt with leakage, distribution shift and calibration on real data. You measure before you claim. You can build an evaluation set and tell an honest improvement from a lucky one. You care about the user outcome more than the technique. Ideas without a clear customer benefit don't get built here, however interesting. Nice to have: time-to-event modelling, noisy or conflicting data sources, financial or private-company data. No finance background needed. The team You'll join our Data & AI team of six and report to Renan, our AI Lead who's been building production models for >10 years. Our engineering team runs the infrastructure, and you shape what runs on it. The stack Core: Python (async, fully typed with Pydantic) and FastAPI LLMs: multiple providers behind our own provider-agnostic layer, with Pydantic AI for typed agents. Evals and observability: Pydantic Evals and Logfire Data: PostgreSQL with pgvector Cloud: GCP (Cloud Run, Cloud Tasks), Docker, GitHub Actions What do we offer? jobs.description: Build with us Since 2004, we've had one clear goal: to make payments and money management effortless for every business in Europe. Today, more than 250,000 companies use Mollie to get paid, manage money and grow – with products designed to be simple, scalable, and dependable. With 950+ Mollies across 14+ locations, we care deeply about autonomy and craft. So we work in small teams, with real ownership, and we trust you to make the right decisions. We're building for the long term, so we provide the tools you need, processes you can rely on, and a balanced work environment to help you do work you're proud of. Sound like your kind of place? Your core activities are discovery, solution design, and implementation support for partner deals, the work that turns a promising conversation into a working integration. You'll also support events and pitches for the commercial team and contribute to process improvement and internal product feedback, so the lessons from one deal make the next one easier. Solutions Engineers are the bridge between technical and commercial teams at Mollie. Strong discovery means partners get solutions that actually fit, pricing negotiations become smoother, and partner needs and product issues make their way back into the business. That's a direct line to how Mollie expands into new products and partner segments. What you'll ship Lead technical discovery sessions to deeply understand and map complex merchant requirements. Design and present tailored payment solutions, clearly mapping Mollie’s APIs and products to specific business needs. Build and deliver custom demos, proof-of-concepts (POCs), and technical workshops that prove our value. Act as the technical expert in the room, partnering with Account Executives to overcome objections and close strategic deals. Collaborate directly with Product and Engineering teams, channeling critical merchant feedback to help shape our product roadmap. What you'll bring 2 to 3+ years of experience in a customer-facing, technical role. Customer-facing experience with a technical product, such as pre-sales, solutions engineering, sales engineering, or technical customer success Comfortable working with APIs, with the ability to demo and build solutions on top of them Strong discovery skills: understanding what a partner needs and judging what's feasible with the product Ability to explain a complex product, including payment methods, sub-products, and the Connect proposition, to both technical and commercial audiences Experience working with both internal and external senior executives stakeholders A technically curious, commercially minded, and customer-minded approach, with clear rules of engagement, comfortable saying no and pushing back when needed Grow your way At Mollie, growth is personal. We believe everyone should have the chance to develop their skills, explore new challenges and shape their career on their own terms. You'll get regular feedback and performance reviews to support your development, with fair and transparent salary reviews along the way. Many Mollies move into new roles or take on new projects to stretch themselves, and we actively hire from within to help you take the next step. No matter if you're aiming for promotion, exploring a different career path or building new skills, you'll be supported with the tools, trust and opportunities to grow your way. jobs.title: Quantitative Researcher - 2027 Graduates
jobs.description: At Graviton, we don't believe the best trading strategies come from following established playbooks. They come from asking better questions. Why does a pattern exist? What is driving it? Is it real or just noise? Can it be explained, modelled and turned into an edge? As a Quantitative Researcher, you'll work on those questions every day. You'll investigate market behaviour, develop quantitative models, build and test hypotheses and turn insights into trading strategies, working alongside researchers and technologists in an environment where an idea on a whiteboard can reach live trading quickly. This isn't a role where the answers are in a textbook. The problems are open-ended, the data is enormous, and finding the answers is the job. Ideal candidates are rigorous thinkers who genuinely enjoy mathematics, programming and figuring out things that aren't obvious, based in our Singapore, London, Amsterdam or US offices. What You'll Work On You'll work across quantitative research and systematic trading, taking ideas through the full lifecycle: question, hypothesis, experiment, model, validation, strategy, production. Depending on your team and research interests, your work would include: Discovering predictive patterns and sources of alpha from billions of market events Formulating hypotheses about market behaviour and designing experiments to test them Applying probability, statistics, optimization and machine learning to build predictive models and quantitative signals for systematic trading Designing robust backtests and statistical tests to distinguish genuine signals from noise Working with large and complex datasets to uncover patterns that aren't immediately visible Investigating market microstructure and how markets behave at different timescales Evaluating strategy performance, identifying weaknesses and continuously refining models Developing research infrastructure and AI-powered tools and agents that make experimentation faster and analysis deeper Working closely with technologists to translate research ideas into efficient, production-ready systems Exploring new techniques in machine learning, statistics and quantitative finance to uncover new sources of edge No two research problems are the same. Good research finds patterns. Great research understands why they exist. What Success Looks Like Successful researchers at Graviton discover new sources of alpha and turn them into robust trading strategies, build models that hold up under real market conditions and not only in backtests, develop a deep understanding of market behaviour, create research frameworks and tools that make the broader team more effective, work with technologists to take ideas from research into production, and communicate complex quantitative ideas clearly and rigorously. Your impact isn't measured by how many models you build. It's measured by the quality of the ideas you discover and what those ideas enable. Who We're Looking For We're looking for exceptional problem solvers who genuinely enjoy mathematics, programming and figuring out things that aren't obvious. Degree in a quantitative discipline such as mathematics, physics, computer science, statistics, operations research or machine learning No active backlogs Strong programming skills in Python and/or C++ Solid grounding in probability, statistics, linear algebra and optimization, with experience in machine learning, statistical modelling or data analysis, whether through coursework, research or personal projects Comfort working with large, complex datasets, and strong analytical thinking A passion for applying quantitative thinking and rigorous research to solve open-ended problems in markets Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex ideas clearly Prior exposure to quantitative research, algorithmic trading, market microstructure, competitive mathematics or machine learning is valuable, but we care more about how you think than whether you've worked in finance b

jobs.description: About Andercore Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials and goods for energy and infrastructure. We execute trade and distribution end-to-end, on our own account, at the speed of compute - and we are becoming the supplier of record for the entire industry. Industrial procurement is a €900B market in Europe alone and the largest manual market on earth. 95% of customers have no direct access to global supply chains. Materials pass through four or five intermediaries before they reach a site, and 40% of the margin evaporates on the way. For decades, the operating system of this industry was people: people to source, negotiate, finance, ship, and sell. We built the alternative from scratch. We are the supplier. We buy from global sources and sell to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, credit, and financing. One request. A firm quote in minutes. Delivered on time. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier. No warehouses. No fleet. No inventory risk. jobs.title: Signal Processing & Data Engineer
jobs.description: Who We Are Limatica measures what batteries whisper. We turn the tiny voltage noise of battery cells into a quality verdict, far faster than conventional tests, and help cell manufacturers cut scrap. We are a team of twelve in Chemnitz and Munich, spanning data, ML, HPC, hardware and industrialization. Early adopters across Europe and Asia already use our technology. In 2026 we move from pilots to production lines, and our data grows faster than our team. What You'll Do Our measurement stations produce several hundred GB of high-resolution voltage data per hour. You own the step from raw signal to reliable answer. Work with novel cell noise data: Derive features from raw time series that make physical sense that hold up in production Build for streaming: Design feature computations that work in streaming mode, at a throughput of up to 10,000 measurements per hour. Make throughput a design decision: Build modular, parameterizable nodes for our distributed processing pipeline and help bring them into our Rust-based production environment. Ship modules, not scripts: Automate evaluations end to end, from raw data to reports for our engineering team and our customers. Own customer projects technically: Assess requirements, communicate interim results and findings, and turn feedback into improvements. What You Bring Measurement experience: A degree in electrical engineering (or comparable) and 3+ years with real-world measurement data. Sampling, noise, filtering and artifacts you know from practice, not just lectures. Physical intuition: You can explain why a feature makes sense, and you prefer a simple, well-understood method over a model nobody can explain. Data at scale: You think in throughput: data formats, intermediate results, distributed and cached processing. Clean engineering: Python, Git, tests and CI/CD as a matter of course. No Rust expertise needed, but the will to learn it. Customer confidence: Fluent German and English, written and spoken. You explain results clearly to engineers and managers alike. Why Limatica Real ownership: Your own part of the pipeline and your first customer project within months. As we grow, this role can grow into technical lead. Learn what few get to learn: Electrochemistry, Rust in production and data engineering at scale, with real cells and international manufacturers. Share the upside: Salary package including virtual stock options. Invest in yourself: Additional holiday for personal learning Flexibility & wellbeing: Flexible hours, hybrid work, further benefits via Guud Card and free beverages What it's like here: You get a lot of trust and a lot of room to shape things. We look for people who stay with a problem until it's solved and who enjoy the moments when a customer launch needs the whole team. Those are the moments where people here grow fastest. This role is intentionally a towards-senior position. You will take on increasing responsibility for pipeline modules and customer projects. Those who help shape the architecture and lead projects independently grow into a senior role with us. Ready to find the signal in the noise? Let's build the future of battery diagnostics together. ⚡ Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

jobs.description: Woven by Toyota  is enabling Toyota’s once-in-a-century transformation into a mobility company. Inspired by a legacy of innovating for the benefit of others, our mission is to challenge the current state of mobility through human-centric innovation — expanding what “mobility” means and how it serves society. Our work centers on four pillars: AD/ADAS, our autonomous driving and advanced driver assist technologies; Arene, our software development platform for software-defined vehicles; Woven City, a test course for mobility; and Cloud & AI, the digital infrastructure powering our collaborative foundation. Business-critical functions empower these teams to execute, and together, we’re working toward one bold goal: a world with zero accidents and enhanced well-being for all. Team Our data platform team is working on accelerating autonomous driving by providing access to petabytes of data collected by our fleet of autonomous and non-autonomous vehicles. Efficient, fast and cost-effective access to data at large scale is key to tackle the hardest problems in AD/ADAS, from developing the Machine Learning (ML) models for perception and prediction of human driving patterns, to increasing the sophistication of our validation and simulation by identifying rare and interesting real-world driving situations. The data ecosystem developed by the London team is a key building block for developing and testing modern AD/ADAS products that will impact millions of customers.  Our ML and Data pipelines are built on-top of the open-source Flyte orchestration framework and are deployed to AWS. Pipeline code is written in Python. We use SQS and Kafka to automate data connections and leverage BigQuery and ElasticSearch for data storage. We believe strongly in automation and testing to ensure delivery of robust and correct systems.  We are a distributed team, working in the UK and US. Who are we looking for? The London Data Infrastructure team is looking for engineers who are passionate about and enable the next generation of automotive software development. The right candidate will have excellent communication skills, solid coding skills, broad knowledge of software development across areas such as Data Infrastructure and Warehouses, Data Ingestion, Compute Frameworks, Observability and Build Infra. Responsibilities: Work on high-impact projects and innovate new solutions to problems in the self-driving space. Work with Computer Vision and Machine Learning engineers on high-impact projects and innovate new solutions to problems in the self-driving space. Understand the complex data requirements of modern ML development and tailor our data ecosystem to these needs. Build efficient data pipelines for ingestion from the vehicle fleet. Work on distributed systems that serve, process and transform large quantities of data in the cloud Mentor junior engineers in their day to day work Design the long term strategy for several of our products Minimum Qualifications: Extensive experience in Python (or another object-oriented language). Experience building reliable, distributed applications for Data Processing or similar areas. Working with RPC protocols such as gRPC/protobuf. Hands-on experience developing cloud applications (e.g. AWS, GCP, Azure). Preferred Qualifications: 5+ years of professional software engineering experience. Experience writing testable and modular code. Experience working in a fast-paced environment, collaborating across teams and disciplines. Experience designing, deploying, and maintaining distributed systems. Data pipelines, data platforms, workflow orchestration, batch processing. jobs.title: Software Engineer, Internship
jobs.description: A World-Changing Company   Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more. The Role   Software Engineers at Palantir build software at scale to transform how organisations around the world use data. As a Software Engineer Intern, you’ll have an opportunity to grow more quickly than you ever envisioned, as you contribute high-quality code directly to Palantir Gotham, Palantir Foundry, or Palantir Apollo: products that are deployed at some of the most important institutions across the public and private sectors. You'll create features used by research scientists, aerospace engineers, intelligence analysts, and economic forecasters, in countries around the world. Palantir's Product Development organisation is made up of small teams of Software Engineers, each focusing on a specific aspect of a product. For example, you might join a team that builds a Foundry front-end application, or a component of the Gotham release infrastructure. We encourage communication and collaboration among teams to share context, skills, and experience, so you'll learn about many different aspects of each product.   Core Responsibilities   As a Software Engineer, you are involved throughout the product lifecycle - from idea generation, design, and prototyping to execution and shipping while also being paired with a mentor dedicated to your growth and success. You'll collaborate closely with technical and non-technical counterparts to understand our customers' problems and build products that tackle them. One of the most effective ways to understand what our users need is to meet them. You may receive an opportunity to tour the assembly line at an auto-manufacturer or join a counter-terror analyst at their desk to really understand their mission and difficulties.   SWE principles include:   • Ownership: We see projects through from beginning to end in spite of obstacles we may encounter. • Collaboration: We work internally with people from a variety of backgrounds — such as other Software Engineers, Product Managers, Designers and Product Reliability Engineers. We also partner with our business development teams (Forward Deployed Engineers, Deployment Strategists) in order to understand and solve our customers' problems. • Trust: We trust each other to effectively handle time and priorities, and don't micromanage. We want people to have the space to think for themselves, while feeling supported by their team.     Technologies We Use   It doesn’t matter what languages you know when you join us, but it does matter that you can write clean, effective code and learn new languages quickly. Our software is constantly evolving, so we need engineers who can do the same. Alongside peers that bring diverse experience - whether you’re a former university TA, switched to CS recently, or are a hackathon enthusiast — you'll build your skills to apply the best technology to solve a given problem. Right now, we use:   • Varying languages, including Java and Go for backend and Typescript for frontend • Open-source technologies like Cassandra, Spark, Elasticsearch, React, and Redux • Industry-standard build tooling, including Gradle, Webpack, and GitHub What We Value Ability to communicate and collaborate with a variety of individuals, including engineers, users and non-technical team members. Willingness to learn and make decisions independently, and the ability to ask questions when needed. What We Require Engineering background in fields such as Computer Science, Mathematics, Software Engineering, and Physics. Familiarity with data structures, storage systems, cloud infrastructure, front-end frameworks, and other technical tools. Experience coding in programming languages, such as Java, C++, Pytho

jobs.title: Senior Front End Software Engineer - Application Development

By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more. We're transforming the way organizations securely integrate their data, so they can then build reliable, critical applications atop that unified foundation. Our customers use Foundry to perform rich analyses that drive core operations within their organizations. They can also build sophisticated, full-fledged programs, such as common operating pictures, alert-triaging inboxes, and resource allocation planning tools driven by rich-ML models.   As a Senior Front End Software Engineer focused on application development in Foundry, you will be responsible for crafting the tools used by thousands of users to build the sophisticated applications that power their businesses. You will be architecting and developing interfaces, state management and access patterns to support data-intensive workflows that are both powerful and approachable. You may spend one day interviewing users to better understand their needs and identifying product gaps to improve. The next day, you might find yourself considering that customer context along with signal gathered from other customers in different industries, brainstorming approaches to handling intricate UX needs with your teammates.   You’ll regularly be faced with sophisticated technical problems, requiring you to scope out the solution design and finding an incremental path to shipping the new features. As part of this, you will own APIs and schemas that power your frontend code, or work with other backend engineers in developing them together.   We’re hiring engineers who are passionate about solving real-world problems and empowering both developers and end-users to work optimally. If you’re motivated to develop reliable, performant, and scalable systems, and to design robust APIs and primitives, this role offers the opportunity to make a significant impact on our products and the people who use them.   Frontline   Foundry Software Engineers may be offered the opportunity to Frontline, an exclusive program unlike any other. This unique, short-term assignment involves being embedded with customers, allowing you to work directly with users and gain firsthand insight into how our products are used and the challenges our customers face. Unlike traditional engineering roles, Frontline immerses you in complex, ambiguous problems, empowering you to deliver impactful solutions across some of the world’s most important industries and institutions.   Some of our most successful products were built on the factory floor, addressing real-world problems for the world's most important institutions. These products were developed by some of our most successful product engineers, who began their careers in roles aligned with Frontline responsibilities, gaining a deep understanding of both our technology and our customers.   Frontliners operate across a broad spectrum of responsibilities, much like a startup CTO. They work in small teams to own the end-to-end execution of high-stakes projects. This spectrum ranges from discussing architecture and building custom web apps to conducting workshops with users and strategizing with customer executives. No two days are alike, as each day is diverse and impactful. By witnessing how customers engage with Foundry and experiencing these pain points firsthand, you’ll gain unique insights that feed directly back into our development process, helping to refine and enhance our products. After your frontline rotation is complete, you will return to your regular role where you can apply the experience and understanding you’ve gained. Core Responsiblitie

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Software Engineer, New Grad - UK Government
jobs.description: A World-Changing Company   Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more. The Role   Forward Deployed Engineering is a radical commitment to the outcome. This is Palantir’s operating ethos. We pioneered this unique position, embedding engineers directly with our customers to tackle their most pressing challenges head-on. As an FDE, you’ll be at the intersection of world-changing problems and impactful technology, shaping solutions where they matter most. From hospital beds to factory floors, Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs) embed themselves in the customer’s reality until the problem is theirs. This requires walking many miles in a customer’s shoes, building past the perimeter of what the product currently offers, and deviating from every pre-existing formula to solve the problem. Whether that problem is “How do we predict and mitigate wildfire risks across a power grid?” or “How can we analyze and adapt a global supply chain to deliver critical parts on time?” You’ll use your technical expertise, creativity, and problem-solving skills to drive real-world impact.   Core Responsibilities   To solve mission-critical problems by deploying software and AI into the high stakes operations of the world’s leading institutions. This requires a ruthless commitment to truth-seeking and prioritizing real outcomes. The work is difficult. The stakes are real. You will work in small, high-trust teams and own projects end-to-end, from the first conversation with a customer, to shipping the product that changes how they operate. You will embed with the customer, the chaos, and the consequences, and will be entrusted with real ownership to: Collaborate with engineers to make architecture and design decisions Wrestle with data at a scale that breaks assumptions and demands invention Build custom applications, LLM workflows, and production solutions engineered for a specific customer's reality Own relationships with stakeholders from the users in the weeds to the executives making the calls As a New Grad, you will be entrusted with responsibility on day 1. You will not be handed a ticket queue. You will not be shielded from the customer, the chaos, or the consequences. FDEs are entrusted with real ownership, operating with real autonomy, and held to a real standard, no matter their tenure. What We Value The drive to solve your customer’s problem. This can translate to: Going where you’re needed most — Embed where and when it matters. Expect 25–50% travel, depending on team and location. Agency — You learn continuously, make decisions with incomplete information, and don't wait to be told what to do next. Embracing the ambiguity — You operate effectively in teams that mix technical and non-technical people, in environments where the objectives shift, the users push back, and the solution demands iteration. Intrinsic motivations — You solve hard technical problems (data structures, storage systems, cloud infrastructure, front-end frameworks) not because you were assigned to, but because that's what it takes to achieve your outcomes. Ruthless goal orientation — You do not operate within a product’s existing boundaries and limitations. You push past them, rewrite them, or discard them entirely. What We Require Engineering degree, preferred in fields such as Computer Science, Electrical and Computer Engineering, Mathematics, Software Engineering, Physics, and Data Science. Proficiency with one or more programming languages, such as Python, Java, C++, TypeScript/JavaScript, or similar. Security clearance or the ability to obtain a clearance. Must be graduating in 2027 or before. To apply, please include the following: An updated resume / CV - please do so in PDF format. Thoughtful responses to our applicatio

jobs.title: Post-doctorant.e : "Elaboration et caractérisation de matériaux inorganiques à partir d’une mine urbaine" - CDD 18 mois
tags: matériaux à haute performance et éco-matériaux
jobs.description: Rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne , c’est s’engager dans une institution où la science et l’innovation bâtissent un avenir plus durable . Une école d’excellence où chacun   a l’opportunité de révéler son plein potentiel et de contribuer à relever les défis de demain . Classée parmi les meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs en France et reconnue mondialement, notre école, membre de l’Institut Mines-Télécom, forme les talents de demain tout en contribuant activement à relever les grands défis industriels, numériques et environnementaux. Avec nous, vous intégrez une communauté de 500 collaborateurs, 2500 étudiants, et participez à un projet ambitieux : conjuguer excellence académique, recherche d’avant-garde et impact sociétal positif. L’Institut Mines-Télécom fédère les grandes écoles françaises autour des défis industriels majeurs, numériques, énergétiques et écologiques. Avec ses 8 Grandes Écoles publiques et 2 écoles filiales, il est le premier institut public dédié aux ingénieurs et managers. Ensemble, nous imaginons et construisons un avenir durable, en formant les acteurs qui façonneront les transitions de demain. Bienvenue dans l’univers des matériaux du futur ! Au centre Science des Matériaux et des Structures (SMS), rattaché au Laboratoire Georges Friedel (unité mixte de recherche CNRS), on décortique la matière pour mieux la maîtriser. Alliages métalliques, céramiques, composites… ici, on explore le lien entre procédés, microstructures et propriétés des matériaux. Grâce à des outils de caractérisation avancée et des modèles multi-échelles, nos enseignants-chercheurs inventent le concept de « Material by design » : concevoir les matériaux dès l’atelier de recherche, pour une performance sur-mesure. 🧠 Vous aimez la science fondamentale qui change le réel ? C’est ici que ça se passe. 🎯  Ce que nous attendons de vous En tant que post-doctorant.e, vous êtes au cœur de nos missions en recherche et innovation affectées au centre Science des Matériaux et des Structures (SMS), rattaché au Laboratoire Georges Friedel (unité mixte de recherche CNRS). Au sein de ce centre, vous conjuguez passion scientifique et impact sociétal, « en décortiquant » la matière pour mieux la maîtriser. Alliages métalliques, céramiques, composites… ici, on explore le lien entre procédés, microstructures et propriétés des matériaux. Grâce à des outils d’élaboration et de caractérisation avancée et des modèles multi-échelles, nous déployons le concept de «Material by design» : concevoir au mieux les matériaux de demain répondant aux enjeux de transition. Vous aimez la science fondamentale qui change le réel ? C’est ici que ça se passe.   Ce post-doctorat s’inscrit dans le cadre du projet VARIMA (VAlorisation des Résidus d’Incinération en Matériaux Avancés) du dispositif Partenariats d'innovation Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes - volet Preuves de Concept. L’incinération des déchets ménagers produit, en plus de l'énergie, des résidus contenant des métaux et des minéraux. Des entreprises récupèrent et recyclent les différents métaux. Cependant, des milliers de tonnes de poussières minérales sont générées et sont généralement envoyées en décharge faute de solution de valorisation. Ce  post-doctorat, d’une durée de 18 mois  vise à étudier la valorisation des poussières d’incinération par deux voies d’élaboration : voie géopolymères et voie métallurgie des poudres. Les matériaux obtenus seront ensuite caractérisés au niveau microstructural mais aussi au niveau des propriétés d’usage (propriétés mécanique et thermique ainsi que la tenue à la lixiviation). Le post-doctorant.e contribuera durant la deuxième année de ce CDD à une étude d’impact relative au procédés développés. · Vous faites preuve d'une grande autonomie dans la conduite de vos travaux expérimentaux tout en montrant une rigueur scientifique exemplaire · Vous rendez compte des résultats à vos encadrants et à l’entreprise parte

jobs.title: Une Ingénieure ou un Ingénieur : procédés et formation en salle blanche microélectronique - Centre Microélectronique de Provence – CDD 2 ans
jobs.description: L’Institut Mines-Télécom est le premier groupe public français de Grandes Écoles d’ingénieurs et de management. Il fédère huit écoles publiques, deux écoles filiales et un vaste réseau de partenaires académiques, industriels et institutionnels. Mines Saint-Étienne, école de l’Institut Mines-Télécom, assure des missions de formation, de recherche, d’innovation et de transfert industriel. Avec 2 500 élèves, 500 personnels et un budget de 50 M€, elle dispose de trois campus spécialisés. Sa stratégie 2023-2027 vise à accompagner les transitions écologique, numérique et générationnelle, tout en contribuant à la souveraineté nationale et européenne en microélectronique et numérique. Le campus Aix-Marseille-Provence, situé à Gardanne, regroupe le Centre Microélectronique de Provence (CMP), des formations d’ingénieurs et de masters, un incubateur technologique et des plateformes de prototypage. Il accueille environ 400 étudiants et 200 personnels de Mines Saint-Étienne et d’entreprises partenaires. Le CMP dispose d’une salle blanche de 700 m², équipée d’une centaine d’équipements scientifiques répartis en zones de classes 100, 1 000 et 10 000. Cette plateforme est utilisée par les équipes de recherche, les membres académiques et industriels de l’association Micro-PackS, ainsi que pour les formations initiales et continues. Ses activités couvrent notamment les procédés de couches minces, la photolithographie, la chimie, la caractérisation physique et électrique des matériaux et dispositifs, le micropackaging, l’électronique imprimée et la préparation d’échantillons. 🎯 Ce que nous attendons de vous Dans le cadre du projet I-novmicro porté par le Campus des Métiers et des Qualifications Industrie du Futur, des modules de formation aux procédés de fabrication en microélectronique sont proposés à des étudiants et apprenants en formation initiale ou continue. La formation se concentrera sur la réalisation de transistor NMOS. Le Centre de Microélectronique de Provence recrute un ingénieur pour mettre en place et dispenser ces formations, gérer les opérations nécessaires au bon déroulement de celles-ci. Vos Missions : Achat d’équipements La personne retenue gérera, dans un premier temps, l’achat de nouveaux équipements destinés aux formations décrites en introduction. Mise en place de la formation La personne sera chargée de développer le module de formation sur le transistor NMOS, en ciblant certains procédés de fabrication. Elle assurera ensuite l’animation des sessions de formation aux procédés microélectroniques associées à ce module. Ainsi, la personne recrutée devra être former aux procédés standard utilisés en microélectronique (front-end), et effectuer les étapes de fabrication de composants, développées dans le cadre des formations dispensées. Elle sera également en charge du développement de nouveaux procédés. Dans le cadre de ces missions, la ou le titulaire du poste devra utiliser des produits chimiques, et donc en gérer les aspects sécurité. jobs.title: Strategic Account Manager - Enterprise Hospitality (Paris)
jobs.description: Lightspeed is looking for an experienced, strategically minded Strategic Account Manager to develop, engage, and closely support our most important enterprise customers in the hospitality segment over the long term. jobs.title: Associate Team Lead - Customer Support (T2)
jobs.description: Résumé Nous recherchons un(e) Associate Team Lead Support N2 / Chef(fe) d’équipe Support N2 pour rejoindre l’équipe Support Niveau 2 de Pennylane, au service des dirigeants d’entreprise et des cabinets comptables. Pennylane est une plateforme de gestion financière et comptable qui accompagne les dirigeants d’entreprise et les cabinets d’expertise comptable dans leur quotidien. L’équipe Support Niveau 2 intervient sur les demandes les plus complexes ou nécessitant une expertise métier et produit approfondie, en lien avec les équipes Support Niveau 1, Support Technique, Produit et Tech. Ce rôle est un poste de management de proximité : tu seras le relais opérationnel du Team Lead Support N2 et accompagneras une équipe de 6 à 12 agents au quotidien pour leur permettre de répondre aux utilisateurs avec efficacité, qualité et empathie. Tu contribueras également au pilotage de l’activité, à l’amélioration continue du support et à des projets transverses. Notre culture Au sein du Support, nous valorisons la transparence, la bonne ambiance, l’entraide et la résilience . Nous restons proches de la réalité de nos utilisateurs, notamment des dirigeants d’entreprise et des professionnels de la comptabilité, afin de traiter chaque demande avec expertise métier, maîtrise du produit et empathie. Cette approche s’inscrit dans la culture Pennylane de Supporting SMEs et de proximité avec les utilisateurs. Nous encourageons le feedback dans les deux sens, le développement de chacun et la prise d’initiative. Nous accordons de l’importance à l’autonomie, à la responsabilité et à la confiance, dans l’esprit de Community of Builders et de Radical Trust . Concrètement, ton quotidien ressemblera à ça Animer les points d’équipe et suivre la charge quotidienne. Accompagner les agents sur leurs tickets, leurs priorités et leurs situations complexes. Réaliser des écoutes ou analyses de conversations pour donner du feedback constructif. Suivre les indicateurs de performance et de qualité de l’équipe, comme le temps de première réponse, le temps de résolution, la satisfaction client et le volume de tickets traités. Participer aux rituels de pilotage opérationnel : suivi de la charge, priorisation des demandes, identification des alertes et coordination avec les autres équipes Support. Remonter les irritants utilisateurs aux équipes Produit, Tech ou Ops. Contribuer à améliorer les process, la documentation et les outils internes. Responsabilités Manager une équipe de 6 à 12 agents sous la supervision du Team Lead Support N2, en les accompagnant dans leur activité quotidienne, leur progression et leur épanouissement professionnel. Donner des feedbacks clairs, réguliers et transparents, réaliser des écoutes et analyses de conversations, suivre les bilans et plans d’accompagnement individuels, proposer des coachings et identifier les besoins de formation. Suivre les indicateurs de l’équipe et contribuer à la qualité du support, notamment le temps de première réponse, la satisfaction client, le temps de résolution, le volume traité, la prise en charge des nouveaux tickets et le suivi des tickets en cours. Participer aux rituels de pilotage et à la gestion des files de demandes communes, notamment lors des rotations de permanence, en identifiant les alertes et en remontant les besoins de renfort ou d’arbitrage. Être force de proposition pour optimiser les process, les outils, la documentation et les modes de fonctionnement du Support. Collaborer avec les équipes support de niveau 1, l’équipe technique, les équipes opérationnelles ainsi que les équipes produit et tech, faire remonter les irritants utilisateurs et contribuer aux projets transverses. Partager les bonnes pratiques avec les autres Associate Team Leads et contribuer à maintenir une communication fluide au sein du Support. Prendre ponctuellement en charge des demandes internes urgentes ou des situations complexes nécessitant l’expertise du Support Niveau 2, en sachant orienter ou escalader lorsque cela

jobs.title: Spécialiste Support Pilotage et Comptabilité (Télétravail complet possible - Bordeaux & Gironde)
jobs.description: Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ? Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance. Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière. Notre vision Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes. Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise. Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients. À propos de Pennylane Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen. En 5 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à : 💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant 💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1000 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches! 🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible 🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours 🚀 Déjà plus de 900,000 TPE/PME et plus de 6000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France ! Pourquoi ce rôle est-il si important chez nous ? En tant que Spécialiste Support Pilotage et Comptabilité, tu te positionnes comme un expert métier et plateforme. Tu es l'interlocuteur privilégié de notre base client qui a choisi Pennylane comme logiciel central de leur gestion comptable et financière. Tu te trouves donc au cœur de l'expérience client 360 et fais profiter les clients et leurs comptables de la pleine puissance de Pennylane au service de leur croissance. Comment vas-tu contribuer au projet ? En tant que membre de l'équipe Support applicatif et technique comptable, tu es le point de relais central entre nos clients Dirigeants, leurs Comptables internalisés et les Cabinets Comptable. Tu es en contact quotidien avec les utilisateurs et tu cherches à comprendre les problèmes qu'ils rencontrent. Après investigation, ton but est d'apporter une réponse ou solution à ton interlocuteur, ou quand cela est nécessaire, d'escalader le problème aux équipes techniques. Tu as aussi la charge d'aider les comptables d’entreprises et de cabinets à intégrer leurs données sur Pennylane afin de faciliter leur migration. Quelles seront tes missions au quotidien ? 3 premiers mois : - Tu te formes sur le produit et les rouages de l'équipe. - Tu apprends tout ce qu'il faut savoir sur notre entreprise, notre vision, et nos différents départements. - Tu apprends à identifier toutes les parties prenantes et à collaborer efficacement au sein de ton équipe, ainsi qu'avec les différents départements. - Tu commences à répondre à des demandes liées à la comptabilité : tu réceptionnes les demandes, les qualifies en t’appuyant sur une compréhension approfondie des principes comptables et apportes des réponses rapides et impactantes. 4 à 6 mois : - Tu gagnes en autonomie et prends intégralement les commandes en assurant un bon suivi des demandes jusqu’à la résolution complète des tickets pour garantir la satisfaction des utilisateurs. - Tu commences

jobs.description: Chez Mistertemp’ Group, nous allions innovation digitale et proximité locale pour révolutionner le monde du recrutement (intérim, CDD, CDI). Présents en France, en Italie, en Espagne et au Canada, nous sommes fiers de figurer parmi les 12 startups HR Tech les plus innovantes en France et d’être lauréats des prestigieux French Tech 120 et Next 40. Grâce à notre plateforme technologique de pointe et à notre réseau de 250 agences, nous poursuivons une ambition claire : devenir le leader européen du recrutement. Pour relever ce défi, nous recherchons des talents créatifs, curieux et passionnés, prêts à évoluer dans un environnement dynamique et en constante transformation. Si ces valeurs vous inspirent et résonnent avec vos aspirations professionnelles, rejoignez l’aventure ! Nous recherchons un(e) Digital & B2B Marketing Manager (H/F) pour renforcer nos équipes au sein de notre siège basé à Clichy. Vos deux objectifs business Générer davantage de RDV qualifiés pour les équipes Grands Comptes ●        Concevoir et opérer des dispositifs d'acquisition et de génération de leads B2B pour alimenter les équipes commerciales Grands Comptes. ●        Mobiliser les leviers digitaux au service de la prise de RDV : SEO/contenu, campagnes, landing pages, nurturing, social selling… ●        Piloter la qualification et le suivi des leads jusqu'au RDV, en lien avec les outils CRM (Salesforce). ●        Suivre la contribution du marketing au nombre et à la qualité des RDV, et optimiser le coût et le taux de conversion. ●        Travailler en collaboration avec les équipes Sales concernées, de la conception à l’optimisation des actions. 2. Développer le business des agences du réseau (250 agences) ●        Animer le réseau et outiller les agences pour booster leur prospection de clients PME : kits et supports marketing, méthodes, temps forts. ●        Concevoir des opérations marketing à décliner localement, en lien avec les Directeurs de Développement (animateurs réseau), pour aider les agences à générer plus de RDV et de business localement. ●        Mesurer l'impact des dispositifs sur le business des agences et les ajuster selon les retours terrain. Sujets transverses Présence digitale du groupe ●        Piloter les sites du groupe et mener le projet de refonte. ●        Définir et déployer la stratégie SEO/GEO et d'optimisation de la conversion. ●        Gérer la présence sur les plateformes d'avis (Google, Trustpilot…) et les autres points de contact digitaux, et piloter la performance web. Référent IA du pôle Marketing / Communication ●        Identifier et déployer des cas d'usage IA (via Claude principalement) pour optimiser les actions Marketing et Communication. ●        Intégrer l'IA dans les process quotidiens du pôle et conduire une veille structurée sur les usages. Pilotage & mesure de la performance ●        Définir les indicateurs clés et produire les reportings de performance des actions marketing et communication. ●        Réaliser des analyses de données internes et de marché pour éclairer les décisions, gérer les enquêtes de satisfaction clients et agences, et assurer une veille concurrentielle. Projets transverses & budget ●        Coordonner des projets transverses avec les équipes internes (Sales, Produit, Data, IT…). ●        Gérer et suivre le budget marketing digital. jobs.title: Responsable commercial EPI H/F
jobs.description: L’entreprise Notre client est un groupe belge reconnu à l’échelle européenne pour son expertise dans les équipements de protection individuelle. À travers sa marque SIP Protection, il conçoit des vêtements et équipements techniques dédiés aux professionnels de la forêt, de l’élagage et de la motoculture. Pour accélérer son développement en France, nous recherchons un commercial de terrain orienté conquête et développement de la distribution professionnelle. Votre mission : développer la marque au cœur des réseaux professionnels Votre priorité est de renforcer la présence de SIP Protection auprès des distributeurs spécialisés, des centrales d’achat et des réseaux de distribution liés à la motoculture, à l’élagage et aux métiers forestiers. Vous identifiez de nouveaux partenaires, prospectez, négociez les référencements et développez les ventes auprès de vos clients. Vous entretenez des relations commerciales durables et mettez en place des actions pour accroître la visibilité de la marque et dynamiser les ventes sur le terrain. Salons professionnels, journées d’achat, événements sectoriels : vous êtes présent là où se rencontrent les acteurs du marché. Vous représentez la marque, valorisez ses produits. En lien étroit avec les équipes commerciales Sioen Pro et le siège en Belgique, vous partagez les retours du marché et contribuez activement à la croissance de la marque en France. Votre profil Vous avez une expérience commerciale dans les EPI, la motoculture, le matériel forestier, le textile professionnel ou un univers technique proche. Vous connaissez idéalement les circuits de distribution spécialisés et appréciez la négociation avec des distributeurs et des centrales d’achat. Développeur dans l’âme, vous aimez prospecter, créer des partenariats et obtenir des résultats. Autonome, organisé et doté d’un bon relationnel, vous savez conjuguer vision commerciale et présence sur le terrain. La pratique de l’anglais vous permet d’échanger avec les équipes européennes. Ce que vous trouverez : Un poste à forte dimension commerciale, avec un marché à développer, des interlocuteurs variés et une réelle autonomie pour faire grandir une marque reconnue au sein d’un groupe européen solide. CDI / Home office partout en France / Déplacements réguliers en France et en Europe / Fixe + bonus / Véhicule de fonction.
