jobs.description: About the Role Elite Editing is seeking experienced freelance journalists and content professionals to support our growing customer reference and case study programs. We call this our Storyteller role, and we are specifically looking for experienced professionals based in EMEA and APAC time zones . Our Storytellers own the storytelling process from interview through finished draft. They lead kickoff calls with our clients and their internal stakeholders, interview their customers and subject matter experts (SMEs), identify the strongest narrative angles within the information they gather, and then write compelling case studies and customer reference stories that adhere to client-specific standards and style guides. This is more than simply working through a list of prepared questions—or turning a transcript into copy. We need skilled storytellers who listen closely, recognize when an answer deserves further exploration, ask intelligent follow-up questions, identify the details that make a story worth telling, and then shape that material into polished, engaging content. Our ideal freelancer has a journalism or professional interviewing background paired with extensive professional writing experience and strong editorial judgment . You should be comfortable speaking with senior business leaders, technical SMEs, and other professionals; able to quickly understand unfamiliar or complex subject matter; and skilled at transforming what you learn into a clear and compelling narrative. What You'll Do You will: Conduct virtual kickoff calls with client stakeholders to understand the goals, context, audience, and desired direction of customer reference stories. Conduct virtual interviews with our clients' customers and SMEs, often involving senior-level or highly technical professionals. Review project background materials and prepare for interviews in advance. Use provided interview guides as a starting point while adapting questions to the conversation. Ask thoughtful, unscripted follow-up questions that uncover meaningful details, examples, outcomes, challenges, and quotable insights. Identify and develop the strongest story angles from interviews, background materials, and client input. Write polished B2B case studies and customer reference stories based on the information you gather, following client-specific briefs, templates, standards, and style guides. Synthesize complex or technical information into accurate, accessible, and engaging narratives for the intended audience. Maintain a professional, confident, and personable presence while representing Elite and our clients on calls. Work collaboratively with Elite's project managers, editors, and other members of the content team throughout the development and revision process. Follow client-specific processes, confidentiality requirements, and project instructions. Job Requirements Successful candidates must: Have substantial professional writing experience , with a portfolio demonstrating the ability to develop clear, engaging, publication-ready content. Have professional experience conducting interviews, preferably in journalism, B2B content, tech, publishing, corporate communications, or a related field . Be located in EMEA or APAC time zones . Have excellent spoken and written English and exceptional verbal communication skills. Be an exceptional listener who can think on their feet and pursue useful lines of questioning in real time. Be comfortable interviewing senior executives, business leaders, customers, and subject matter experts. Be able to absorb unfamiliar information quickly and ask credible, informed questions about complex topics. Have strong editorial judgment and be able to identify the narrative, details, and supporting evidence that will make a compelling story. jobs.title: Virtual Bookkeeper
jobs.description: About Strong Roots Accounting Strong Roots Accounting is a small accounting firm based in Fort Worth, Texas, serving small businesses and nonprofits with accurate, reliable bookkeeping and financial insight. We are not a factory. We are not a revolving door. We are a close-knit, values-driven team that operates with intention — every client gets one point of contact, consistent communication, and work they can count on every single month. We exist to be a collaborative partner to businesses and individuals, providing accurate, reliable insights that allow them to make informed decisions with confidence and grow. Our vision is bigger than bookkeeping: we are building something that creates meaningful opportunities for people to build long-lasting stability and confidence in their future. We are growing — intentionally and carefully — and we are looking for the right person to grow with us. This Is Who We Are We operate by a set of values and principles that are non-negotiable. They are not posted on a wall and forgotten. They are how we show up every day. Core Values: Trust Quality Contribution Our Principles: Honesty and accuracy above all. Be curious. Ask why. And solve problems. Rapid, responsive, and reliable communication. Repeatable processes are the only option. If you read those and felt something — keep reading. If you read those and they felt like just words, this is not the right fit, and that is okay. This Is Who We Are NOT Looking For We are a small team doing meaningful work. There is no room for the following: People who cut corners and hope no one notices People who go quiet when things get hard People who need to be micromanaged to deliver People who treat accuracy as optional People who are not genuinely curious about the work they do People who are not committed to the client behind the numbers If any of that describes you, we genuinely wish you well — just not here. The Role The person best suited for this job is organized, detail-oriented, and personable. If you like to put your headphones on and dive into the numbers, you'll love this job. Our team gets to complete something from start to finish every day — there's real joy in putting your head down and checking tasks off one by one. But this role takes more than the obvious skills. The person who thrives here is caring: caring about the work itself, about what it means for the client, for their peers, and for the company as a whole. That caring is what drives someone to get the details right, ask the question instead of guessing, and take pride in a quality product. It also takes someone intrinsically motivated. We won't be standing over your shoulder — we trust you to hold yourself accountable and stay on track. Strong Roots is the most mission-minded place many of our team members have ever worked. We care about our people first, and that shows up in the quality of our work, the strength of our client relationships, and the culture we've built together. This is a remote, backend bookkeeping position supporting our Client Relationship Manager. You will not have direct contact with clients — your job is to execute the bookkeeping work accurately, quietly, and on time so our team can deliver a seamless experience on the client-facing side. You will manage end-of-month reconciliations across approximately 30 small business and nonprofit client accounts. jobs.title: Senior Firmware Security Architect, Networking
jobs.description: NVIDIA Networking product security team is looking for an outstanding technical security architect with hands-on experience to help us improve the security posture of NVIDIA networking products. In this role you will partner with firmware, hardware, and architecture teams on the security architecture, to reduce risk, threats, and vulnerabilities while driving new security features that affect millions of devices all over the world! What you'll be doing: Be involved in the security architecture of NVIDIA Networking firmware — trust boundaries, privilege separation between firmware domains, device identity and key storage, secure boot and chain of trust, and secure update and anti-rollback flows. Perform security threat modeling of firmware and embedded subsystems across NVIDIA Networking products. Analyze complex firmware and hardware/firmware interactions to identify security weaknesses, including boot flows, privileged execution environments, and host- and network-facing management interfaces. Define security features and mitigations spanning the full device lifecycle — provisioning, attestation, debug authorization, runtime hardening, and field update. Guide the engineering teams throughout the implementation. Translate threat models into actionable security requirements and architectural decisions, and review designs and implementations against them. Partner with hardware and ASIC architects to specify the security primitives firmware depends on, and define how they are used across the product line. Drive secure development practices for firmware — memory-safe coding patterns in C, static analysis, and fuzzing of firmware-exposed interfaces — and make sure development processes meet security and coding standards. What we need to see: Academic degree in computer science, electrical engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience). Demonstrated experience of 8+ years in product security, firmware security, or security research, including hands-on work with embedded or firmware codebases. Experience defining security policy models — authorization schemes, RBAC, and administrative role separation — including how policy is expressed, enforced, and administered in production. Familiarity with applied cryptography (including secure boot, code signing, and attestation), threat modeling, common attack vectors, and mitigation techniques. Ability to work independently, and collaboratively in a constantly evolving environment. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. Ways to stand out from the crowd: M.Sc. or PhD in computer science, electrical engineering, or related technical field. Experience with hardware/software interfaces in networking devices — register and MMIO programming models, DMA, mailbox and doorbell mechanisms, PCIe configuration and management interfaces, and the firmware that drives them. Experience with hardware roots of trust and hardware-enforced isolation (MPU/MMU, secure enclaves, fuse/OTP-based provisioning) in SoCs or ASICs. Hands-on experience with networking software — device drivers, control plane, management interfaces, or embedded network operating systems — and an understanding of how these components interact with firmware. Familiarity with high-scale deployment, the data center security ecosystem and its operational challenges. With highly competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package, NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world's most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people on the planet working for us and, due to unprecedented growth, our special engineering teams are growing fast. If you're a creative and autonomous engineer with a genuine passion for technology, we want to hear from you. Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 184,000 USD - 287,500 USD for Level 4, and 224,000 USD - 356,500 USD for Level 5
